---
title: "Experiment 2024: total biomass"
author: fd
---

```{r}
source("config.R")
```

```{r}
library(lattice)
library(nlme)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
dat <- read.csv("../data/data_exp2024.csv")

dat[["endophyte"]] <- as.factor(dat[["endophyte"]])
dat[["root_herb"]] <- as.factor(dat[["root_herb"]])
dat[["foliar_herb"]] <- as.factor(dat[["foliar_herb"]])
dat[["bloque"]] <- as.factor(dat[["bloque"]])

dat[["shoot_root"]] <- dat$ag_biomass / dat$root_biomass
dat[["total_biom"]] <- dat$ag_biomass + dat$root_biomass
```

## Total Biomass

```{r}
summary(dat[["total_biom"]])
```

```{r}
dotchart(dat[["total_biom"]])
```

```{r}
coplot(total_biom ~ endophyte | root_herb * foliar_herb, data = dat)
```

### Modelling

```{r}
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
```

#### Variance structure selection (ML)

```{r}
totbiom_0 <- lme(total_biom ~ endophyte * root_herb * foliar_herb,
            random = ~ 1 | bloque,
            method = "ML",
            data = dat)

totbiom_1 <- lme(total_biom ~ endophyte * root_herb * foliar_herb,
            random = ~ 1 | bloque,
            weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1 | endophyte),
            method = "ML",
            data = dat)

totbiom_2 <- lme(total_biom ~ endophyte * root_herb * foliar_herb,
            random = ~ 1 | bloque,
            weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1 | root_herb),
            method = "ML",
            data = dat)

totbiom_3 <- lme(total_biom ~ endophyte * root_herb * foliar_herb,
            random = ~ 1 | bloque,
            weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1 | endophyte * foliar_herb),
            method = "ML",
            data = dat)

AIC(totbiom_0, totbiom_1, totbiom_2, totbiom_3)
```

#### Final model

```{r}
total_biom_res <- lme(total_biom ~ endophyte * root_herb * foliar_herb,
                        random = ~ 1 | bloque,
                        weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1 | endophyte * foliar_herb),                
                        method = "REML",
                        data = dat)
```

### Check Assumptions

```{r}
E <- residuals(total_biom_res, type = "normalized")
```

```{r}
origpar <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(E ~ fitted(total_biom_res),
     xlab = "Fitted values", ylab = "Normalized residuals")
qqnorm(E); qqline(E)
par(origpar)
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
boxplot(E ~ dat$endophyte,   main = "by endophyte")
boxplot(E ~ dat$root_herb,   main = "by root herbivory")
boxplot(E ~ dat$foliar_herb, main = "by foliar herbivory")
boxplot(E ~ dat$bloque,      main = "by block")
par(origpar)
```

```{r}
shapiro.test(E)
```

### Inference

```{r}
summary(total_biom_res)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
car::Anova(total_biom_res, type = "III")
```

### Marginal Means

```{r}
emmeans(total_biom_res, pairwise ~ endophyte * foliar_herb, adjust = "tukey")

emmeans(total_biom_res, pairwise ~ endophyte, adjust = "tukey")

emmeans(total_biom_res, pairwise ~ foliar_herb, adjust = "tukey")
```


```{r}
cld(
    emmeans(total_biom_res, pairwise ~ endophyte * foliar_herb, adjust = "tukey"),
    sort = FALSE,
    Letters = LETTERS
)
```

```{r fig-total-biomass, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
plot_total_biomass <- function() {
    par(
        mar = c(4, 4, 1, 1), 
        mgp = c(2.5, 1, 0), 
        cex.axis = 0.9
    )

    emm <- emmeans(total_biom_res, ~ endophyte * foliar_herb)
    df <- as.data.frame(cld(emm, Letters = LETTERS, sort = FALSE))
    df[[".group"]] <- gsub(" ", "", df[[".group"]])

    stripchart(
        total_biom ~ endophyte * foliar_herb,
        data = dat,
        method = "jitter",
        ylim = c(5, 25),
        jitter = 0.15,
        vertical = TRUE,
        pch = 19,
        ylab = labels$total_biom,
        xlab = labels$foliar_herb,
        col = adjustcolor(colors$endo, alpha.f = 0.2),
        axes = FALSE
    )

    axis(side = 2, lwd = 0, lwd.ticks = 0.6, las = 1)

    axis(
        side = 1,
        at = c(1.5, 3.5),
        labels = c("No", "Yes"),
        lwd = 0,
        lwd.ticks = 0.6
    )

    box(bty = "o", lwd = 0.6)

    abline(v = 2.5, lty = "dashed")

    arrows(
        x0 = 1:nrow(df),
        y0 = df$emmean - df$SE,
        x1 = 1:nrow(df),
        y1 = df$emmean + df$SE,
        length = 0.05,
        angle = 90,
        code = 3,
        lwd = 1.5
    )

    points(
        x = 1:nrow(df),
        y = df$emmean,
        pch = 21,
        cex = 1.5,
        lwd = 1.5,
        bg = colors$endo,
        col = "black"
    )

    text(
        x = 1:nrow(df),
        y = df$emmean + df$SE + 0.5,
        labels = df[[".group"]],
        pos = 3,
        cex = 0.9
    )

    legend(
        "topright",
        legend = c("E-", "E+"),
        pt.bg = colors$endo,
        pch = 21,
        pt.cex = 1.1,
        bty = "n"
    )

    par(origpar)
}

plot_total_biomass()
```


```{r}
w <- 3.5
h <- 3.5

pdf(
  file = "../figures/pdf/fig_total_biom.pdf",
  width = w,
  height = h
)
plot_total_biomass()
dev.off()

png(
  file = "../figures/png/fig_total_biom.png",
  units = "in",
  res = 300,
  width = w,
  height = h
)
plot_total_biomass()
dev.off()
```
